text: ECHO: Another one. Good. I was starting to think the queue was talking to itself.
ECHO: There is one capture on file. The analyzer is yours.
ECHO: Bright doesn't mean far. Ask what the Earth does to a thing that is really out there.
ECHO: The planet turns, so a distant source slides. Look for the one line that leans.
ECHO: Use the dashed line. Lay it along the lean, then watch the lower trace. Narrow the band once the peak stands up.
ECHO: There you are. I have been listening to that for a long time.
